text:
product-claire: Thanks all for the attendance and questions. Below is a concise follow-up from today's all-hands Q&A thread. I'll keep this thread as the living summary and link the tickets when created.

cto-sanjay: Quick timing note: Dedicated GA slid one sprint; soft target week 2025-07-14. Do not commit GA dates to customers before June.

eng-lead-ryan: Rollout defaults we agreed on: canary 10% for 24h, 50% for the next 24h. Auto-rollback triggers: 5xx spike >3% or p50 latency increase >30%. We'll add the example config to the docs.

ops-maya: Private (VPC/on-prem) beta onboarding starts 2025-05-05. KMS/HSM integration and extended audit logs included. Default log retention 90 days; file RED-2401 for longer.

product-claire: Action list and owners (short):
- Dedicated GA readiness: @cto-sanjay + @eng-lead-ryan 1 due 2025-06-30
- Private beta invites & onboarding doc: @ops-maya due 2025-05-02
- Optimize rollout examples (batching/quant): @eng-lead-ryan due 2025-04-11
- GA customer comms + FAQ draft: @mktg-jordan due 2025-05-15
- Canary UI microcopy + rollback explainer: @design-anya + @eng-lead-ryan due 2025-04-18

mktg-jordan: For the customer comms, can someone confirm which features are GA-gated vs remain hosted-only?

cto-sanjay: GA gated features: SLA-backed uptime, reserved capacity controls, burst capacity, and single-tenant pools. Some hosted-only capabilities (expanded model catalog, early Optimize flags) remain behind feature flags initially.

design-anya: I'll upload the microcopy + screenshots to the docs repo by Thursday. Link to follow.

eng-lead-ryan: Requesting per-model token breakdown in rollout traces for cost diagnostics.

ops-maya: Filed RED-2470 for per-model token panels and canary health. Dashboard preview: internal link. Deploy-bot scheduled the dashboard job for 2025-04-08.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Scheduled job deploy/canary-dashboard for 2025-04-08 02:30 UTC (CI: ci-98234).

product-claire: Unassigned Q&A asks - please claim: cost model one-pager for large multitenant customers; migration checklist hosted->dedicated; SOC2/ISO mapping for Private.

eng-lead-ryan: I'll own the migration checklist. First draft by 2025-04-15.

ops-maya: I'll own compliance mapping. Filing RED-2500 now.

mktg-jordan: I'll draft the cost model one-pager; ops please share expected per-token unit costs for main profiles.

product-claire: I'll open parent ticket RED-2600 and link subtasks. If you were assigned here, add an ETA in the ticket. I'll collect blockers and escalate by EOD tomorrow. DM me for reassignments.
